title: Add worldToScreen / screenToWorld coordinate conversion to the engine camera

stateNumberOne.note: Captain, this build is a code-only engine change — two pure coordinate functions, a factory method, a Camera type field, and their unit tests — none of which shows up on a screen, and the PRD deliberately leaves the editor/example wiring that would exercise them out of scope. The example game does render fine, so the engine compiles and runs, but that proves nothing about the new methods. The decisive evidence would have been your vitest suite, and it never ran: 'vitest: command not found', exit 127 before a single test executed — a broken runner invocation, not a failing test. So every criterion is honestly untested. Get vitest running inside packages/engine and read that result before you accept this.

title: Example game: add a top-right "STEPS walked" HUD readout in dev mode

stateNumberOne.note: Captain, your STEPS readout is there and it reads right: 'STEPS 0' in white monospace, pinned to the top-right corner on load, exactly where your drawing puts it, and the world around it is untouched. The engine's own test suite is fully green (6 files, 60 tests, exit 0), which settles the pure stepDelta/formatStepCount utils. I found no contradiction with the drawing. What I could not confirm is the counting-up as the player walks and the several internal/dev-mode behaviors — movement is keyboard-driven and I have no keypress action, and the test summary names files, not those individual behaviors — so those stand as untested, which is why I land on medium rather than high.
